en: Cross Owakudani: See the Volcano Before Fuji
zh: 穿越大涌谷：先看火山，再看富士山
ja: 大涌谷を越える：富士山より先に火山を見る

p.src: The cable car from Gora ends at Sounzan. Follow the ropeway transfer rather than looking for the same vehicle to continue. Soon after departure, the trees fall below the cabin and white fumaroles cut through exposed grey and ochre ground; at the deepest point, the valley floor is about 130 metres beneath the ropeway. Look for the vents, the edge where vegetation thins, and the maintenance roads before searching the sky for Mount Fuji. Those details explain why Owakudani is more than a viewpoint. Everyone leaves the cabin at Owakudani; continuing towards Togendai requires boarding again from the other platform.

caption.zh: 早云山至大涌谷的第一段索道。先看谷地、喷气孔与维护道路；富士山是否出现，不影响这段路的价值。
caption.ja: 早雲山から大涌谷へ向かう最初の区間。谷、噴気孔、管理路を先に見る。富士山が見えるかどうかで、この区間の価値は変わらない。
caption.en: The first ropeway section from Sounzan to Owakudani. Read the valley, fumaroles, and maintenance roads first; the value of this crossing does not depend on Mount Fuji appearing.

p.src: The four stations appear in travel order. Each section uses the operator's approximation of ten minutes; it is not a promise that the day's service will run to time. Owakudani is both the compulsory cabin change and the one place in this chapter where the type of stop should be chosen in advance. Allow 45 to 60 minutes for the public overlook and black eggs, 75 to 95 minutes for the overlook and a seated meal, or reserve 90 to 120 minutes around a booked nature-trail slot, with lunch added separately. These are LazyTravel planning ranges, not operator guarantees. If gas, weather, or equipment closes the line or area, follow staff and rebuild the route from the last transport hub still open.

caption.zh: 早云山、大涌谷、姥子、桃源台的行进顺序与三种停留方式。站距不按比例；彩色时间为计划范围，不是运营时刻。
caption.ja: 早雲山、大涌谷、姥子、桃源台の順序と三つの滞在方法。駅間は縮尺外で、色付きの時間は計画用の目安であり、運行時刻ではない。
caption.en: Travel order from Sounzan through Owakudani and Ubako to Togendai, with three stop choices. Station spacing is not to scale; coloured times are planning ranges, not a timetable.

p.src: At the public railing, read the view in three layers: managed paths and barriers in front, fumaroles and plants tolerant of acidic ground in the middle, then the collapse terrain on Kamiyama's northern side and Kanmurigatake behind. The white plumes contain hydrogen sulphide, but changing smell and volume cannot tell a visitor whether the site is safe that day. The area was once called Oojigoku, the Great Hell; it was renamed Owakudani for the imperial visit of 1873. Use of its heat developed in the Meiji period, followed by systems supplying hot water to onsen facilities. Seeing railings, instruments, and maintenance roads beside the landform makes the point: public access here depends on continued management.

caption.zh: 公共展望区的栏杆、喷气地表与山脊。栏杆内外的界线属于景观本身；现场信号和开放范围以当天公告为准。
caption.ja: 一般見学エリアの柵、噴気地帯、稜線。柵の内外を分ける境界も景観の一部であり、信号と公開範囲は当日の案内に従う。
caption.en: Railings, fumarole ground, and ridges at the public overlook. The managed boundary is part of the place; use the day's notice for live signals and accessible areas.

p.src: As checked on 17 August 2026, the operator prohibits travel between Sounzan and Ubako by anyone with allergic asthma, bronchial or other respiratory disease, heart disease, a pacemaker, or poor health. It asks passengers highly sensitive to volcanic gas, pregnant passengers, infants, and older passengers to weigh the ride carefully. The nature trail has stricter age, health, and mobility rules; the public overlook may also close independently. Gas is monitored continuously and the whole ropeway may be suspended. Before climbing to Sounzan, check the ropeway notice, JMA's Hakoneyama information, and Hakone Town's safety page separately. On site, follow staff.

p.src: The flavour of a black egg is not the mystery; the shell and its place of preparation are. Eggs spend about 60 minutes in an 80°C hot-spring pool, then about 15 minutes in steam close to 100°C. Iron in the spring components reacts with hydrogen sulphide to form black iron sulphide on the shell. Inside, the white and yolk retain the colours of an ordinary boiled egg. The saying that one egg adds seven years of life links Enmei Jizo with the auspicious number seven. It is folklore, not a health benefit. As checked on 17 August 2026, eggs are sold in packs of four for JPY 500, only at Kurotamago-kan and Gokuraku Chaya in Owakudani, and may sell out. Sharing one pack is enough to make both the black shell and the local story memorable.

caption.ja: 一袋四個の黒たまご。黒いのは殻で、むけば普通のゆで卵である。大涌谷での短い軽食として味わい、健康食品とは考えない。
caption.en: One four-egg pack: the shell is black, while the peeled egg remains an ordinary boiled egg. Treat it as a short Owakudani snack, not a health product.

p.src: Black eggs and a hot drink make a short break, not lunch before a mountain walk. For a seated meal, use OWAKUDANI KITCHEN on the station's second floor. As checked on 17 August 2026, it runs 10:30 to 16:00, last order 15:30, with no reservations. Kurotamago-kan's quick-service counter currently runs 09:00 to 16:00 with curry bread and other light food. These are contemporary visitor meals, not traditional Hakone cuisine. Eating is prohibited on the nature trail, so eat before check-in or after the walk. Hours and sell-outs change; when ryokan dinner is fixed, schedule lunch instead of borrowing time from the next transfer.

p.src: The nature trail is not a few extra steps beyond the public overlook. After a very small eruption in 2015, access around the crater remained restricted for years. The roughly 700-metre route reopened in March 2022 with booking, check-in, helmets, and guidance by safety monitors; the official walk takes about 40 minutes. It includes a grade of about 10 per cent, 37 metres of height change, 82 steps, and seven shelters. The current schedule has four sessions a day with up to 30 people each. Check in at the Owakudani Information Center by the Hakone GeoMuseum entrance and pay the JPY 800 safety contribution cashlessly; on-site explanations are in Japanese only. Preschool children, pregnant visitors, people with listed heart or respiratory conditions, cane users, and anyone unable to run quickly without help are excluded. Read every official condition before booking and allow for cancellation due to weather or volcanic conditions.

caption.zh: 预约制自然研究路的台阶、护栏与避难设施。实际进入须满足官方年龄、健康和行动条件，并接受安全监视员引导。
caption.ja: 予約制自然研究路の階段、柵、避難施設。実際の入場には公式の年齢、健康、行動条件を満たし、安全監視員の誘導に従う必要がある。
caption.en: Steps, barriers, and a shelter on the reserved nature trail. Actual entry requires the official age, health, and mobility conditions and guidance by safety monitors.

p.src: Without a nature-trail booking, plan for the public area and do not assume that a same-day slot will appear. With a booking, use its time to structure the half-day: leave enough margin for check-in, then fit lunch around it. On a public-area stop, choose between black eggs and a meal when time is short; do both only when there is enough time. Cloud hiding Mount Fuji is not a reason to linger once Owakudani itself has been seen. During suspension or closure, do not use an unopened path or gamble on the next service restarting. Follow staff, switch promptly to the next confirmed-open place, and avoid missing the lodging dinner or return connection.

p.src: After the cabin change at Owakudani, the ropeway passes Ubako and descends towards Togendai. Mineral grey gives way to forest green, then Lake Ashi appears between the ridges. Even with Mount Fuji behind cloud, the view provides enough information for the next decision. The four guides look first at wind patterns on the water, the height of low cloud on the ridges, and the direction of the pier. The crossing is still worthwhile without a Fuji view. At Togendai, the route divides among sightseeing boats, lakeshore buses, and services towards lodging areas. Do not board the first vessel automatically; check wind, the next departure, and the direction of the hotel. Chapter 5 begins with that choice and treats Lake Ashi as a day's route, not a viewpoint to postpone until perfect weather.

caption.zh: 大涌谷换舱后向桃源台下降。即使富士山没有出现，芦之湖、山脊与云层仍足以帮助判断下一段路线。
caption.ja: 大涌谷で乗り換え、桃源台へ下る。富士山が見えなくても、芦ノ湖、稜線、雲から次の経路を判断できる。
caption.en: Descending towards Togendai after the Owakudani cabin change. Even without Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi, the ridges, and cloud are enough to guide the next route decision.
